tariff_from.description: From this day energy is priced by the URE tariff again, with no trade fee.

contract.title: Contract prices – {tariff}
contract.description: Copy the prices from your invoice, section **Rozliczenie – sprzedaż energii**, column **Cena jedn. netto**. That price already includes the excise (0.005 PLN/kWh); the integration subtracts it, so the "Energy Price (netto)" sensors show 0.005 less. If the price changed during the billing period and the invoice has two dated lines, copy the newer one. Distribution and time zones come from the Enea Operator tariff.

data_description.trade_fee: Monthly net trade fee from the invoice (e.g. 9.82 PLN with an e-invoice). 0 if there is none.
data_description.valid_from: The day you started paying these prices, usually the start of the contract or of a new price list. Earlier hours keep the prices they had; Energy Dashboard history from this date is recalculated on the next start. {earliest} at the earliest.
